## Purpose
Renders the "Steps" tab of a pipeline run's results view — a three-level drill-down (overview spine → agent detail → task detail) showing real-time agent reasoning, tool calls, gate strips, and clarification rounds for a running or completed pipeline.

## Shape
- `AgentThinkingTab` — the main export; owns L1/L2/L3 selection state (`selectedAgentId`, `selectedTaskIndex`) and renders `StepsOverviewSpine` (L1), `AgentDetailPanel` (L2), or `TaskDetailPanel` (L3) depending on selection.
- `EmptyState` — placeholder shown before any pipeline data exists.
- A `useEffect` fetches gate-event rows via `getRunGateEvents` (reused from the Audit tab) to drive inline "Review gate — approved" strips in the overview.
- Construction/task-progress reconciliation logic (`totalTasks`, `completedTaskCount`, `constructionComplete`, `taskStatusFor`) merges `task_progress` events with `wave_*`/`subagent_*` state into one nested block for the build-loop's per-task display, guarding against a race where a later agent starts before the last task's progress event lands.
- `TokenUsageSummary` renders in a footer strip when `pipelineState` is present.

## Why this shape
The former flat agent-timeline list plus several inline sub-sections were retired and re-homed inside `AgentDetailPanel` per an explicit "single implementation, no dual list" invariant (INV-3) referenced in the file's comments; the component is also deliberately generic — no workflow-type branching (SC-001) — so one drill-down structure serves every pipeline type, with idle agents rendered as pending rather than hidden.
